verified_facts.text: The hotel is located within Iguazú National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: To access the hotel, located within the National Park, it is mandatory to purchase a ticket per person

verified_facts.text: Iguazú National Park forms the natural border between Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay and is one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World.
verified_facts.excerpt: It forms the impressive natural border between Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay, generating a magnificent and unique sight. This natural reserve of 67 thousand hectares is one of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has views of the Devil's Throat.
verified_facts.excerpt: With its privileged views of the Devil's Throat, guests enjoy an unparalleled connection with nature

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an infinity pool in front of the Devil's Throat, with a pool concierge service.
verified_facts.excerpt: swimming in our 50-meter infinity pool in front of the incredible Devil's Throat while enjoying the services of our pool concierge

verified_facts.text: Children have their own paddling pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The youngest members of the family have access to their own paddling pool.

verified_facts.text: The gym has views of Iguazu Falls and is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: Work out in the only gym with views of Iguazu Falls. With state-of-the-art equipment in its two training areas, cardiovascular and bodybuilding, and towels, water and teas at your disposal. Open 24 hours.

verified_facts.text: Yasi Spa treatments and rituals use exclusive yerba mate products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our treatments and rituals are performed with exclusive yerba mate products.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a hydrotherapy water circuit with hydromassage jets, included in the RedLevel category and reserved for guests over 16.
verified_facts.excerpt: A relaxing 30 minute water circuit based on saline chlorination. The best way to enhance the therapeutic benefits of the circuit's hydromassage jets. Included in RedLevel category. Exclusive for over 16 years.

verified_facts.text: Waterfall-view rooms have balconies with views of Iguazú Falls.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grab your camera and head to your balcony to take that perfect snapshot of Iguazú Falls.

verified_facts.text: The two-story Royal Suite RedLevel has a terrace with a private heated infinity pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: This two-story suite boasts a stunning terrace featuring a private infinity heated pool.

verified_facts.text: Family Rooms have two connected bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and private balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: With two connected bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and private balcony with views of the jungle.

verified_facts.text: RedLevel rooms and suites are on the upper floors with views of the Iguazú falls.
verified_facts.excerpt: RedLevel rooms and suites are all located on our upper floors, offering unspoiled views of the monumental Iguazú falls

verified_facts.text: RedLevel rooms include a Nespresso coffee machine, exclusive toiletries and 600-thread count cotton bed linen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nespresso coffee machine with daily capsule restocking, exclusive toiletries and premium 600-thread count cotton bed linen.

verified_facts.text: RedLevel guests have an exclusive lounge for meetings, reading or working.
verified_facts.excerpt: This sophisticated space, exclusive for RedLevel guests, is a unique place to hold a casual meeting, read or work in a relaxed and distinguished atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: The Rainforest Ecological train to the Devil's Throat trail leaves from outside the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: take the Rainforest Ecological train from outside the hotel

verified_facts.text: Under the Full Moon takes guests to the Devil's Throat balcony by moonlight on full moon nights.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique experience happens 5 nights every month, on full moon days, in the Iguazu National Park. You will reach the balcony of the majestic Garganta del Diablo (Devil's Throat) under the moonlight

verified_facts.text: The Great Adventure explores the jungle and takes a boat on the river to the foot of Iguazu Falls.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will explore the jungle and enjoy the river aboard a boat to the foot of the stunning Iguazu Falls.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers exclusive activities for Meliá Rewards members, which may vary by season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gran Melia Iguazú offers a range of exclusive activities for Melia Rewards members, designed to provide guests with unique experiences during their stay. Please note that the activities may vary according to the season.

verified_facts.text: Asador, under chef Ernesto Palomar, celebrates open-flame cooking that combines Argentine tradition with a contemporary perspective.
verified_facts.excerpt: Under the direction of chef Ernesto Palomar, Asador celebrates open-flame cooking through a proposal that combines Argentine tradition with a contemporary perspective.

verified_facts.text: Alter Rooftop Bar has panoramic views of Iguazu Falls and serves selected wines and signature cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Alter Rooftop Bar reflects the exclusive nature of its privileged location with panoramic views of Iguazu Falls and a carefully selected choice of wines and signature cocktails.

verified_facts.text: Entrance to Iguazu National Park is not included in the room rate; tickets are bought on the park's website.
verified_facts.excerpt: Entrance to Iguazu National Park is not included in the rate. Tickets must be purchased on the Iguazu National Park website.

verified_facts.text: Every guest must buy a park ticket on the Iguazu National Park website and show it at check-in to access the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: it is mandatory to purchase a ticket per person through the Iguazu National Park website and present it at the hotel reception at the time of check-in

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 10 km from Cataratas del Iguazú Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: 10 km fromCataratas del Iguazú Airport

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds the Hoteles Más Verdes sustainability ecolabel from the Association of Tourism Hotels of Argentina.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ecolabel awarded by the Association of Tourism Hotels of Argentina (AHT) that certifies the implementation of good ethical, environmental and socially responsible practices in the hotel.

unresolved.text: World Travel Awards named the hotel Best Resort in 2025.
